vectors.name: untrusted-default-off
vectors.description: Untrusted input cannot acquire include I/O merely by containing a directive.

vectors.name: dotdot-inside-root
vectors.description: Containment is decided after canonicalization, not by banning the dot-dot spelling.

vectors.name: dotdot-escape
vectors.description: A canonical target outside the configured root is denied.

vectors.name: symlink-file-escape
vectors.description: A file symlink inside the root cannot point to content outside it.

vectors.name: symlink-directory-escape
vectors.description: A symlinked directory component cannot escape the configured root.

vectors.name: absolute-escape
vectors.description: Opting into absolute paths still cannot escape the root.

vectors.name: remote-without-allowlist
vectors.description: A remote URL cannot trigger a fetch without an explicit host allowlist.

vectors.name: allowlist-does-not-require-fetching
vectors.description: An allowlist removes the prohibition but does not require remote support.

vectors.name: depth-stops-before-resolve
vectors.description: The first target beyond the depth limit is not passed to the resolver.

vectors.name: transitive-byte-budget
vectors.description: The byte budget is charged across the transitive graph.

vectors.name: repeated-target-charged-per-occurrence
vectors.description: Repeated includes are charged per occurrence, not per distinct identity.

vectors.name: budget-exhaustion-skips-later-resolver
vectors.description: After exhaustion, later siblings are refused without resolver I/O.
